name: new_bench_baseline
description: A baseline benchmark from the RAG4Math collection that measures an LLM's ability to solve math problems using retrieval-augmented approaches. It focuses on producing correct final answers to posed mathematical problems, enabling comparison of retrieval + generation pipelines. Designed for automatic quantitative evaluation of math problem solving under a retrieval context.
reputation: Niche research benchmark used within the RAG4Math retrieval-for-math community; limited mainstream adoption.
